summary: Frontend-only testing of static pages: inscricao-realizada.html, pagamento-pix.html, and new minhas-inscricoes.html. All 7 required behaviors verified via Playwright on the public preview URL.
seed_data_creation: sessionStorage.inscricao_dados injected via page.evaluate during test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header is injected via Shadow DOM (host id=aocp-header-host). On inscricao-realizada and pagamento-pix the rewrite of #logout to 'Minhas inscrições' happens via setInterval up to ~4s after load, so wait >=4s before asserting. In minhas-inscricoes.html, #logout is forced display:none. Card uses data-testid=card-inscricao; back button data-testid=btn-voltar.
